message: 親密に親睦会

name: Misa
message: 「This is what I brought.」

name: Ria
message: 「Potatoes, carrots, onions, and chicken, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is the chicken tenderloin?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...?! You turned Sasami into something like this...?!」

name: Misa
message: 「A-As if I would ever do something like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm asking about the cut of meat, not your pet.」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh, right, this is thigh meat.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How safe. You might as well have gone with wings, tail, or knee cartilage.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like we're making yakitori...」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, what about you then, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't be so hasty. My gift to you is sobagaki.」

name: Synn
message: 「How safe.」

name: Misa
message: 「How safe.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How safe.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey now, hey now! Have you even tried authentic sobagaki before?!」

name: Misa
message: 「The moment it has 'soba' in the name, it makes total sense.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are sobakasu, soba tea, sobameshi, soba sushi, soba tofu, and soba croquettes all out too?!」

name: Synn
message: 「They're all delicious, so it's fine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Deliciousness is justice.」

name: Ria
message: 「I didn't know there were so many soba dishes~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've prepared an ingredient even more surprising than the Treasurer's!」

name: Synn
message: 「I was already surprised the moment you were at the school gate.」

name: Misa
message: 「I almost thought we were at a fish market」

name: Ria
message: 「So Lolotte-chan brought tuna and octopus, huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I caught them at Tsukinowo Park」

name: Misa
message: 「Haah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But frozen tuna isn't as tasty as fresh tuna, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, on the contrary. According to this guidebook, the amount of the umami component 『inosinic acid』 in frozen tuna surges all at once when it thaws」

name: Misa
message: 「That's amazing. It really has everything written in it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though, Rolo-chan, you don't actually know what that means, do you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Deliciousness is an aesthetic」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Anyway, just knowing it's tuna already has me excited」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't care about the octopus?」

name: Synn
message: 「I really, truly want to eat toro!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You honest guy, you!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone's ingredients have so much impact that I'm starting to get a little scared to bring mine out……」

name: Synn
message: 「You're no slouch either, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Mine are…… cheese fondue, wine, and fish & chips, though……」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku…… Trying to make a hot pot out of this--as expected of Ria-chan, you're diabolical」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This is how a yaminabe ought to be, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「Freshly baked French bread. If we're going to eat it, I'd rather eat it as is……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President. You're surprisingly chicken, aren't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Speaking of poultry」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haah…… I am so very excited to see what kind of harmony Japanese, Western, and Chinese ingredients will play!」

name: Ria
message: 「There isn't anything Chinese, though\s02」
